[[File:Anoat_Quadrant-Hoth-Star_Tours.jpg|thumb|right|250px|The quadrant on a star map at Star Tours' [[Tomorrowland Starport]]]]
The '''Anoat Quadrant''' was a region of [[Realspace/Legends|realspace]] where the planet [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] was located.<ref name="ST">[[Star Tours (real-world)|''Star Tours'']] {{C|Tokyo and Paris only}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
A galaxy map depicting the various destinations of the [[Star Tours/Legends|Star Tours]] travel agency is seen in the queue of the [[Star Tours (real-world)|''Star Tours'']] attraction at [[Disneyland Paris]] and [[Tokyo Disneyland]]. The map suggests Hoth is in this area, as well as the sixth planet in its system, which is contradicted by many other [[Star Wars Legends|Legends]] sources.<ref name="ST" />
